description: Forgejo Actions runner lane policy for the EdgeVector local forge. Since 2026-10-08 no repo is gated on Forgejo: `lastgit`, the last one, moved to GitHub (EdgeVector/lastgit#5). Both lanes are retired. The heavy lane is retired (its repo-scoped runners served fold and exemem-infra, both on GitHub). The merge-gate lane is retired (it gated lastgit only). The gaming PC runners (pc-forge-runner, pc-heavy-runner) were retired on 2026-09-29. A retired lane needs no runner: last-stack-fold-ci-health and last-stack-why-stopped Class C report ok for it and last-stack-forge-runner-lanes --check --live does not demand mac-forge-runner. Setting merge_gate.retired to false puts the Forgejo runner checks back.

merge_gate.purpose: Pre-merge ci-required only. It gated the lastgit repo, the last repo on Forgejo; that repo moved to GitHub on 2026-10-08, so this lane is retired.
merge_gate.notes: RETIRED 2026-10-08 (lastgit moved to GitHub). Mac merge runner is host-only macos-arm64 (docker label dropped 2026-07-13). No docker lane exists: the PC pc-forge-runner that served docker/* was retired 2026-09-29. Do not attach long release/deploy workflows to these labels. The labels and homes stay listed so the separation check and a future re-activation keep working.

heavy.purpose: RETIRED 2026-09-30. Long-running non-gating work on Mac host runners for fold tags and exemem-infra deploys. Both repos are on GitHub now (GitHub Actions), so no Forgejo heavy runner is expected. Re-adding a heavy lane is a deliberate decision. Never a required pre-merge status.

workflow_routing.example: release.yml / deploy jobs: runs-on: macos (Mac host). Leave ci-required needs: limited to merge-gate jobs only.

heavy.notes: pc-heavy-runner (PC docker, label heavy) was retired 2026-09-29. The Mac host runners for fold and exemem-infra (com.edgevector.forgejo-runner-host, -host-exemem-infra) are not expected or watched any more; Tom may leave them loaded or bootout them.

proof.expected: Local discovery only. The heavy lane is retired (heavy.retired), so heavy_ok is true without a heavy runner. The merge-gate lane is retired (merge_gate.retired), so no merge-gate runner is demanded; the check fails only when a merge-gate home advertises the heavy label.
